title: My Taste and Style Augmentation
reported_observation: Suno says My Taste learns from listening and creation habits. When Style Augmentation is used via the Styles magic wand, the resulting description reflects those habits; My Taste is enabled by default.
creator_interpretation: Personalization should be logged as a potential confound, especially in multi-user prompt replications.
our_hypothesis: The same textual prompt could have different effects when personalized style augmentation or account-level preferences enter the workflow.
